title: Protocol for efficient human MSC chondrogenesis via Wnt antagonism instead of TGF-β
protocol: Harvest MSCs from culture flasks by trypsinization and centrifuge the cells at 300 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend the cell pellet in complete culture medium at a concentration of 2×10^5 cells/mL.
Add 1 mL of cell suspension to 15 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the tubes at 450 × g for 10 min.
Slightly loosen the cap of centrifuge tube and incubate the tubes at 37°C in humidified incubator with 5% CO2 for 16 h (overnight).
Replace the complete culture medium with Wnt antagonism-based chondrogenic medium.
Carefully remove the liquid from the centrifuge tube and avoid aspirating the MSC pellet.
Slowly add the 2 mL of Wnt antagonism-based chondrogenic medium along the tube wall to prevent disturbing the pellet.
Refresh the Wnt antagonism-based chondrogenic medium.
Carefully remove the liquid from the centrifuge tube and avoid aspirating the MSC pellet.
Mix 2 mL of Wnt antagonism-based chondrogenic medium along the tube wall to prevent disturbing the pellet.
Maintain the culture for 10–20 days.
Refresh the medium every 2–3 days.
Extract total RNA from pellets following the manufacturer's operation manual.
Reverse transcribe the extracted RNA to cDNA.
Perform qPCR with primers of chondrogenic marker genes.
Wash sample pellet with PBS.
Fix samples with 0.5 mL 4% paraformaldehyde for 10 minutes at 25°C.
Wash fixed samples with PBS.
Rinse samples in 0.1 N HCl for 5 minutes.
Stain the samples with 0.5 mL Alcian blue solution (pH 1.0) for 1 hour.
Wash pellets with 0.5 mL 0.1 N HCl for 5 min.
Repeat washing with 0.5 mL 0.1 N HCl until the solution is colorless.
Rinse pellets with distilled water.
Transfer pellets to a 24-well plate and conduct microscopic imaging at 40x magnification using bright field.
Wash pellets with PBS for 5 min.
Transfer pellets to PCR tubes and remove supernatant.
Digest pellets with 5 μL collagenase I (3 mg/mL in PBS) at 37°C for 3 h.
Aspire the supernatant carefully.
Dissolve pellets with 20 μL of 6 M Guanidine HCl by rigorous pipetting.
Transfer the supernatant to a transparent 96-well plate.
Add 30 μL of ddH2O (total 50 μL) to each well and measure absorbance at 650 nm.
Wash sample pellet with PBS.
Fix samples with 4% paraformaldehyde for 10 min at 25°C.
Embed the MSC pellet in OCT compound and freeze at -80°C.
Cut the pellet into 10 μm sections using a cryostat.
Place sections onto microscope slides.
Rehydrate the sections by washing them with distilled water three times for 2 min each.
Rinse sections in 0.1 N HCl for 5 min.
Stain sections with Alcian blue solution (pH 1.0) for 30 min.
Wash stained sections with 0.1 N HCl for 5 min.
Rinse stained sections with distilled water.
Rehydrate the sections by dipping them into graded alcohol solutions (70%, 95%, and 100% ethanol) for 2 min each.
Clear the sections with xylene for 2 min.
Mount the slides with cover slips using mounting medium.
